column1: # test/quarantine.tsv — flaky Go tests out of the gate's verdict while they are fixed
# One test per line, five tab-separated fields:
# The issue is the open bug that tracks the fix: quarantine is not a fix, the issue stays open.
# The expiry is at most 30 days after the day the line is added. Past it the line lapses: the
# test is back in the gate, and the `quarantine` job of ci.yml says so once on the issue. Fix the
# test, or renew the line with a reason in the issue. The name must be unique in the module
# (go test -skip matches it in every package), which internal/repodocs checks with the rest.
